text: My sense here is of curiosity and anticipation. The clean, bright, and modern spaces invite contemplation about the intersection of technology, design, and human experience. The 'R+D' display particularly signals innovation, progress, and a future orientation. I feel somewhat disoriented due to the tilted angles, but this also prompts me to reflect on perspective—how the way we view our surroundings shapes our understanding. I feel engaged, reflective, and eager to learn more about the ideas being presented in this environment.
